visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair, wearing a white sleeveless top and black skirt, walks on a tiled sidewalk next to a street. She talks on a smartphone, expressing exaggerated laughter followed by a look of disappointment. (2) Inside a vehicle, the woman sits in the passenger seat, yawning. Beside her, a man in a khaki shirt wearing a white Guy Fawkes mask drives. He points towards the rear of the car. (3) At the back of the white vehicle, the woman opens the trunk to reveal several stacked boxes and green storage bins. The masked man stands nearby. (4) In a dim indoor environment, the woman holds a small glowing blue device. She reacts with a dramatic scream, covering her mouth. Two boys in the background are seen laughing. (5) At a dining table, two young boys are seated. The woman opens a silver refrigerator, finding only a glass of milk inside, appearing confused. (6) Back at the table, the woman serves the milk. The masked man gestures to a cabinet. The woman opens it and pulls out a package of dental floss with a look of annoyance. (7) One boy holds a phone up. The woman enters a state of high-energy anger, with red graphic overlays and large text appearing on screen. (8) A boy in glasses puts a finger to his lips in a hushing gesture. He holds a miniature white cake with a green '9'. (9) A screen recording shows a mobile app game interface with green backgrounds and various 'Happy Birthday' windows popping up. (10) The woman and the boy sit together, holding promotional items and Uber Eats branded boxes, smiling at the camera.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Disappointment Sketch -> Surprise Reveal -> Campaign Explanation -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video utilizes a humorous 'slice-of-life' comedy format to promote the 9th-anniversary campaign of Uber Eats in Taiwan. It starts with a series of sketches where a woman is disappointed by her family's perceived lack of birthday effort, only to reveal the '9' theme. The intent is to grab viewers' attention through relatable family dynamics and then inform them about specific rewards like the '9-second' game and potential prizes like a 365-day breakfast deal or an iPhone 17 Pro.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of Uber Eats, display of branded boxes and merchandise, and a detailed explanation of a company-wide anniversary promotion.
